```plato

    //==
    // # Distance and rope constraints
    //
    // A distance joint holds the separation of its two anchors inside
    // [MinLength, MaxLength]. Equal bounds make a rigid rod, a zero minimum makes a
    // rope, and anything between is a rod with slack. Inside the range the joint
    // does nothing at all — that is what makes it a rope rather than a spring, and
    // it is why the constraint is solved only when it is violated.

    // How far the current separation lies outside the joint's allowed range:
    // positive when the anchors are too far apart, negative when they are too
    // close, and zero inside the range.
    DistanceError(joint: DistanceJoint, separation: Number): Number
        => separation > joint.MaxLength.Amount
            ? separation - joint.MaxLength.Amount
            : (separation < joint.MinLength.Amount ? separation - joint.MinLength.Amount : 0.0);
```
